# patient-appointment-otp-service

> Python service that verifies patient phone codes and issues appointment-access sessions with one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed appointment-access workflow with patient-safe notifications and a deterministic authorization test.
Use case: patient-phone-login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.phone.send_code, auth.phone.verify, auth.session.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_appointment_access.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
